readme_summary: Raven Core integration/staging tree ===================================== To see how to run Ravencoin, please read the respective files in the doc folder Ravencoin is an experimental digital currency that enables instant payments to anyone, anywhere in the world. The Ravencoin platform also lets anyone create assets (tokens) on the Ravencoin network. Assets can be used for NFTs, STOs, Gift Cards, and fractional ownership of anything of value. Ravencoin uses peer-to-peer technology to operate with no central authority: managing transactions and issuing money are carried out collectively by the network.
